exposure: Maternal age (<17 years, 17-19 years, 20-24 years, 25-29 years, 30-34 years, 35-39 years, ≥40 years)
cohort: 798,674 primiparous women with singleton births in Sweden from 1992 to 2010
finding: Teenage mothers experienced more vaginal births and fewer complications while older mothers experienced more cesarean sections and complications, suggesting the need for age-specific antenatal care.
